content: Conclusions. We have developed a new method of learning different data manipulation schemes with the same single algorithm. Different manipulation schemes reduce to just different parameterization of the data reward function. The manipulation parameters are trained jointly with the target model parameters. We instantiate the algorithm for data augmentation and weighting, and show improved performance over strong base models and previous manipulation methods. We are excited to explore more types of manipulations such as data synthesis, and in particular study the combination of different manipulation schemes.
